en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Abu Muhammad Al Zuhly, from Abu Ayoub Al Madainy, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The soul, when it saves its foodstuff, is settled’.
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from abu Muhammad al-Dhuhliy from abu Ayyub al-Mad’iniy from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al- Rahman from ibn Bukayr from abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘When a soul reserves its sustenance it settles down.”
